description: Compares 2 to 4 products side by side for the client’s quantity: the price per piece and the total (order fees included, without shipping), the minimum, the sales shown on their product page with their date, how reliable the seller is (manufacturer or wholesaler, rating, year), the dispatch time, then Rabbit’s recommendation and its reason. Call it as soon as they ask which one to take. Counts one product page per product against their daily limit.

items.description: The `produit` reference returned by a search (starts with “p”).

quantite.description: The number of pieces the client said.
